description: Search Capgo docs, discover plugins, and find free browser tools without an account.
instructions: Connect to https://capgo.app/mcp/public with Streamable HTTP; no account or credentials needed. Tools: capgo_search_docs, capgo_list_plugins and capgo_list_free_tools. Account operations (apps, bundles, channels, builds) need the authenticated server at https://api.capgo.app/mcp.
